rationale.intervention_reconstruction: The hypothesis proposes thermochemical nitriding, while the paper used laser cladding of a WNbMoTaV RHEA powder. These are fundamentally different kinds of interventions (surface diffusion treatment vs. additive coating).
rationale.condition_agreement: The hypothesis mentions room temperature and up to ~200°C testing with pin-on-disk wear, while the paper performed microhardness and reciprocating wear tests at room temperature. The processing conditions (nitriding vs. laser cladding) are completely different.
rationale.mechanism_agreement: The hypothesis invokes hardening via nitride formation and nitrogen diffusion, whereas the paper's mechanism relies on solid-solution strengthening, lattice distortion, and grain refinement in a BCC RHEA coating. These are different general classes of mechanisms.
rationale.outcome_agreement: Both predict increased surface hardness and wear resistance relative to untreated TC4, which is the same property and direction in general terms.
